description: Offline hardening, denylist unit test, tool scripts, and final polish. Ensures the release APK has no INTERNET permission, adds a pubspec denylist test, creates tool/check_offline.md, and cleans up any remaining main.dart scaffold code. Depends on all previous FEATs.
steps: Audit android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml one final time. Confirm <uses-permission android:name='android.permission.CAMERA'/> is present and <uses-permission android:name='android.permission.INTERNET'/> is absent. If flutter_riverpod, go_router, camera, image_picker, shared_preferences, or path_provider have merged INTERNET permission via their own manifests, add a tools:node='remove' override: <uses-permission android:name='android.permission.INTERNET' tools:node='remove'/> (and add xmlns:tools='http://schemas.android.com/tools' to the manifest tag if not present). Document the finding in docs/DECISIONS.md.

Create test/pubspec_denylist_test.dart. The test reads pubspec.yaml as a string and asserts that none of the following strings appear in the dependencies or dev_dependencies sections: 'http:', 'dio:', 'firebase_', 'google_analytics', 'firebase_analytics', 'crashlytics', 'amplitude', 'mixpanel', 'sentry'. Use dart:io to read pubspec.yaml relative to the test file (use Platform.script or a relative path). The test must fail if any denylisted package name appears as a dependency key.

Create tool/check_offline.md. A manual checklist: (1) Enable airplane mode on the device; (2) Launch the app; (3) Tap Scan ingredients → scan screen loads; (4) Add mock detections → chips appear; (5) Tap Done → review screen loads; (6) Tap Find recipes → results appear; (7) Tap a recipe → detail screen loads and mock LLM streams; (8) Verify no network error dialogs appear; (9) Repeat 5 times and record pass/fail. Also note: 'To verify the release APK has no INTERNET permission, run: aapt dump permissions app-release.apk | grep INTERNET (expect no output)'.

Create tool/push_models.sh. A bash script that runs: adb push <local_model_path> /sdcard/Android/data/com.example.snapfood/files/models/model.gguf. Include a comment explaining how to find the correct external files path with adb shell and path_provider's getExternalStorageDirectory(). This script is documentation/tooling only, not shipped in the APK.

Final cleanup: delete any dead code or TODO stubs left from FEAT-001 placeholders. Ensure lib/main.dart is still the thin entry point (ProviderScope + AppShell only). Run flutter analyze one final time and fix any remaining warnings (unused imports, deprecated APIs). Ensure every file has a copyright/license header comment if the team requires it (assumption: no license header required for hackathon; record this assumption in docs/DECISIONS.md).
Run the full test suite one final time and confirm all tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml has CAMERA permission and no INTERNET permission (verified by inspection and documented)
test/pubspec_denylist_test.dart passes and would fail if http: were added to pubspec.yaml
tool/check_offline.md exists with the 9-step checklist and aapt command
tool/push_models.sh exists with adb push command and documentation comments
lib/main.dart is a thin entry point with no scaffold code
flutter test passes all tests including pubspec_denylist_test.dart
